blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte’s admission that he was unaware that his sister, Vice President Sara Duterte, holds an interest in GenCorp Industries Inc. amounted to a “confession.” That’s according to private prosecutor Lorna Kapunan who on Tuesday also argued that it showed his failure to exercise “due diligence.” GenCorp Industries
